correctness.rationale: The vertex-to-vertex, vertex-to-midpoint and midpoint-to-midpoint shortest-path formulas are derived by minimizing endpoint Hamming distances. The Walsh decomposition separates frequencies |S|=0,1,>=2. The mean block has d-1 midpoint contrasts a-2 and one centered class contrast 2(a-2)/(d+2); singleton frequencies give eta+ and eta- (negative by trace<0, determinant 4a>0), and higher frequencies contribute -2 and zero. Multiplicities sum to (d+2)2^(d-1). Boundary d=1 path gives (-2,-2/3,0), d=2 gives (0,4,4) inertia, and d>=3 gives (d,d2^(d-1),2^d-d). The direction-1 minus direction-2 midpoint coefficient vector is zero-sum and has c^T D c=2a(a-2)>0, making the Schoenberg all-scales Gaussian criterion fail at small t. I independently reconstructed BFS distance matrices and numerically checked centered eigenvalues for d=1..5 exactly to floating tolerance 1e-8; proof of all d rests on the Walsh block identities, not finite checks.
residual_risks: Finite BFS/eigenspectral checks cover d<=5 only; higher d follows only from the analytic Walsh argument.
